verdict.rationale: Extend documents schema-driven extraction on a dedicated Extraction Schema page. Extraction is a synchronous or asynchronous API endpoint, and its responses return structured fields with per-field confidence scores and citations back to the source page. A long-term user independently praises the accuracy of its data extraction. Missing for 10: the schema page is evidenced only by its title, so there is no detail that the schema is standard JSON Schema; no evidence that outputs are validated or guaranteed to conform to the schema; no hands-on example of a schema-in, fields-out round trip.
